subject: english
stem: City lights can confuse young sea turtles moving toward the ocean. Shielded lights point downward and reduce the bright glow near the beach. What is the central idea?
options: Young turtles live under city lights.
Better-directed lighting can reduce harm to sea turtles.
All beaches should close at night.

optionRationales.reason: Young turtles live under city lights.：未提。
Better-directed lighting can reduce harm to sea turtles.：問題與 shielded solution 都指減少干擾。
Sea turtles need brighter streets.：方向相反。
All beaches should close at night.：未提。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「標題、重複概念與各句共同說明的對象指向文章核心」可推出 Better-directed lighting can reduce harm to sea turtles.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 Better-directed lighting can reduce harm to sea turtles. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
